children: UBS is requiring candidates for junior investment banking roles to demonstrate AI capabilities, according to Jiemian News. The Swiss banking group is asking graduates and interns seeking to join its global banking and markets division in 2027 to show how they use AI to improve work output and efficiency. The report said the move highlights how AI is reshaping graduate recruitment at some of Europe's largest banks.

title: UBS Requires Junior Investment Banking Candidates to Prove AI Skills
